title: Reading — Words, Lines, and a First Passage
label: ch:ka-modala-oduvike
canDo: I can read a Kannada word cold, tell a naming sentence from a locating one, and hold a whole passage about one place without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: Thirty-one words standing in one spot and pointing, where ಇಲ್ಲಿ and ಇಲ್ಲ sit one letter apart and do opposite work.
